h: List of Nigerian politicians' children linked to financial crime cases goes round
p: A compiled list of children of prominent Nigerian politicians facing financial crime allegations is drawing attention online. It includes the 16-count money laundering case against former Attorney-General Abubakar Malami, his wife and son, who have pleaded not guilty to charges involving about ₦8.7bn.
more: The Malami case is before a Federal High Court in Abuja.
The defendants deny all the charges.
